summary: Finstad frames the Gaza conflict as Iranian-backed terrorism, declares pride in standing with Israel, and pledged continued Iron Dome support. He voted for the April 2024 $95B aid package delivering $17B in military assistance to Israel, and on the day of the October 7 attack stated he would always stand united with Israel. He also voted Yea on H.R. 6090, the IHRA-based Antisemitism Awareness Act. Vote for Peace rated him Opposed in the general election.
